recommendation: Keep the commit. The core binding should remain required, and generated/profile summary text should continue to point Observation.status required binding references at terminologies.html#required.
issue_request: FHIR-16349 requested changing Observation.status from a required code-list binding to extensible to allow additional states such as released and signed. The Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept the required binding and directed such act states to Provenance, with Observation.status preliminary until completion and then final.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16349 was found. The cross-referenced FHIR-16315 was applied in git 2ebd7c6f7f, changing the historical Observation final status definition to include the released/signed Provenance and preliminary-until-final guidance; later source restructuring carried that wording into the current Observation status CodeSystem.
additional_context: Current Observation.status already has required binding strength in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml, and source/observation/codesystem-observation-status.xml contains the approved Provenance guidance. The remaining defect was in source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml, where the active Vital Signs profile summary labeled Observation.status as required but linked required to terminologies.html#extensible. FHIR-34055 later noted the Provenance markdown rendering and recorded that this guidance was fixed in R5.
reconciliation: Changed the two Vital Signs profile summary extensions from terminologies.html#extensible to terminologies.html#required for the Observation.status required binding link. No binding strength, value set, status code, or Provenance guidance was changed.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml: changed the Observation.status required binding hyperlink in structuredefinition-summary valueMarkdown from terminologies.html#extensible to terminologies.html#required.
source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml: changed the matching tools profile-summary valueString hyperlink from terminologies.html#extensible to terminologies.html#required.
